- [USER] User inquired about the trail system and outdoor activities in Banff National Park.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Banff National Park is located in Alberta, Canada, and has over 1,600 km (1,000 miles) of trails.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular trails in Banff National Park include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Johnston Canyon: A family-friendly hike through a canyon with waterfalls and a scenic viewpoint.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Plain of Six Glaciers: A moderate hike with stunning views of six glaciers, alpine valleys, and mountain peaks.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake Agnes Tea House: A challenging hike to a historic tea house overlooking Lake Agnes.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mount Fairview: A strenuous hike offering panoramic views of surrounding peaks and valleys.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other outdoor activities in Banff National Park include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mountain biking: Over 190 km (120 miles) of designated trails for various skill levels.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Canoeing and kayaking: Popular spots include Lake Louise and Moraine Lake.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fishing: Lakes and streams home to brown trout, rainbow trout, and arctic grayling.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Skiing and snowboarding: Three ski resorts - Mount Norquay, Sunshine Village, and Lake Louise Ski Resort - with a total of 8,000 acres of skiable terrain.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wildlife viewing: Home to elk, moose, bighorn sheep, grizzly bears, and wolves.
- [USER] User expressed enthusiasm about the information, stating "Wow, that sounds amazing!"
- [USER] User asked about scenic drives in Banff National Park.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scenic drives in Banff National Park include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Icefields Parkway: A 232-km (144-mile) drive between Lake Louise and Jasper with views of glaciers, mountains, waterfalls, and wildlife.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bow Valley Parkway: A 48-km (30-mile) drive through wildlife-rich valleys and past turquoise lakes.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake Minnewanka Loop: A 26-km (16-mile) drive around the largest lake in Banff National Park.
